title: Native Windows Staging broker host bootstrap with fail-closed installation authority

phases.objective: Provide a native Windows SCM service skeleton and bounded Staging-only installation plan that cannot grant DBA authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Build a credential-free ServiceBase host and verify the elevated-only installer guards.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Native host compiles and selftests; non-admin installation stops before any OS mutation; no DBA or Production authority is generated.
steps: Compile native ServiceBase host with built-in Windows compiler, without a third-party unsigned wrapper.
Verify signed-out source SHA, executable hash, default read-only installer and exact deployment certification.
Reject unauthorized interactive execution and unprivileged Windows service installation.
Require explicit Staging-only inert service scope and protected virtual service identity for future admin operation.
Do not open database, network or cryptographic operations in the inert ServiceBase class.
assertions: Native code contains no network/DB/filesystem writes or handler for signed operation tickets.
Installer checks exact main/source/deployed in-container SHA, binary digest and elevation before modifying the OS.
No automatic GitHub source code approval can authorize a DBA operation or backup/restore.
Staging service bootstrap and tests cannot mutate Production or grant DBA.
